{{Quote|Like I said, they may not have been the most noble bunch ever to fight for the Alliance, or its most famous squadron, but I can't think of anyone else I'd rather have beside me when the thermal detonators are flying and I'm down to my last clip. Wherever they are, whatever they're up to, may the Force be with them.|Col Serra|<ref name="Star Wars Battlefront: Renegade Squadron">''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Renegade Squadron]]''</ref>}}
The '''Renegade Squadron''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Alliance Military/Legends|military]] unit of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], and other types of [[Fringer/Legends|fringers]] assembled and commanded by [[Col Serra]] at [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] request. The unit consisted of underworlders recruited by Serra from around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Assigned to advanced black operations, very few knew of the existence of the squadron and their actions which kept the Alliance alive.

==History==
===Formation===
{{Quote|It didn't matter what they'd been before. All that mattered was that they were willing to fight&mdash;and maybe die&mdash;for the Alliance. I tracked them down and offered them whatever it took. In the end, I found enough of what I was looking for.|Col Serra|<ref name="Star Wars Battlefront: Renegade Squadron" />}}
Renegade Squadron was ordered into existence by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Commander [[Col Serra]] was tasked to find potential [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]]; he found many in [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] and other such places. Many had criminal backgrounds, but Serra's task was to find elite fighters, not "[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|farmboys and dreamers]]." Renegade Squadron's first major battle was the [[Evacuation of Yavin]], where the squadron was tasked with overseeing the evacuation of the planet. In addition, Renegade Squadron had to retrieve communication logs stolen by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] scout and destroy databanks with valuable information. Renegade Squadron was successful in their first mission.
[[File:MosEisley-SWBRS.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Renegade Squadron in action on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]]]

===Finding a new base===
The squadron's next [[Battle of the Graveyard|mission]], at [[the Graveyard]], the remains of what used to be [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], resulted from the battle at [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. They had to retrieve a [[Bail Organa's data holocron|holocron]] made by [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] and encased in [[Phrik/Legends|phrik]], one of the strongest substances in the galaxy, strong enough even to survive the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction of Alderaan]]. The holocron had a list of potential bases for the Rebel Alliance, in the case of the evacuation of the base on Yavin 4. After engaging the [[Interdictor-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Interdictor''-class Star Destroyer]] and retrieving the holocron, they were prepared to jump into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], but were attacked by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], who was also looking for it. Renegade Squadron damaged his ship and drove him off. Finally, the squadron destroyed the gravity well projectors on the Star Destroyer that were preventing their jump to [[Lightspeed/Legends|lightspeed]].

After meeting with Han Solo on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] to repair damage sustained in the [[Alderaan system/Legends|Alderaan system]], the squadron was preparing to leave when they were discovered by [[IG-88B|IG-88]], who alerted the Imperial forces. Renegade Squadron fought off Imperial forces and IG-88 while Han worked on the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. Han and Renegade Squadron escaped Ord Mantell with their lives.

Afterwards, Renegade Squadron learned from Alliance Command that [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] had been captured by Imperial forces and was en route to the prisons on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]. Renegade Squadron intercepted the Star Destroyer carrying him, infiltrated the ship, and brought Ackbar back to the safety of a Rebel ship.

[[File:Renegade_Squadron_member.jpg|thumb|right|180px|A member of Renegade Squadron]]
Ackbar told the squadron that he had been investigating [[Boz Pity/Legends|Boz Pity]], a cemetery world, as a location for a Rebel base. He then took a scout party to [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]]; however, he never made it there. Boba Fett boarded the ship, handed over Ackbar to the Imperials, and sold his ship, crew, and droids on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Renegade Squadron landed on Tatooine and rescued the slaves, additionally destroying at least two [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-STs]].

The squadron headed back to their base on Boz Pity, but they were unaware that Boba Fett had put a tracker in one of their droids. Fett discovered their base, and a few hours after Renegade Squadron landed on Boz Pity, an Imperial planetary strike force, with an [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]], attacked. During the battle, the squadron learned that Ackbar had been wounded during the battle, and they saved his life by bringing him a [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tank]]. Soon after, they successfully evacuated.

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Renegade Squadron raided the [[Imperial Weapon Research Facility]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], where they uncovered the plans and fabrication chambers for a [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]]-based weapon stationed on a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] known as the [[Conqueror (superlaser)|''Conqueror'']]. The location was defended by a [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith acolyte]] by the name of [[Namman Cha]], whom Renegade Squadron defeated. They left the planet with critical information necessary for the destruction of this new threat to the Rebel Alliance.

===Evacuation of Hoth===
{{Quote|Everybody has heard of the Empire's victory at Hoth that day. What no one knows, though, is that without Renegade Squadron, nobody would have made it off Hoth alive.|Col Serra|<ref name="Star Wars Battlefront: Renegade Squadron" />}}
[[File:Renegade_squadron_TCG.jpg|thumb|left|290px|The Renegade Squadron in [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]]]]
Time passed as Renegade Squadron resided on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], from where they would launch attacks on the Empire. However, they were discovered, and the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] ensued. The squadron was in charge of protecting the [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] team. In addition, they had to destroy databanks that contained sensitive information, and set charges to destroy Echo Base and any Imperial in it. Downing an AT-AT with particle cannons, Renegade Squadron was ready to leave when they were set upon by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. At least [[Unidentified Rebel Vanguard (Battle of Hoth)|one member]] of the squadron was [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Choke|choked]] to death by Vader. They fought off Vader and escaped. They were the last squadron off Hoth, and without them, not one [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] would have left Hoth alive.

As soon as Renegade Squadron left the planet, it was forced to fight the Imperial fleet in space. In addition, they had to escort the last transport to an area safe for the jump to hyperspace, as the ion cannon had been destroyed by then. During the battle the squadron faced prototype versions of [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defenders]]. Renegade Squadron, at the request of Alliance command, entered the Imperial hangar and stole a TIE Defender for further study. Before they could flee, however, they were engaged by Darth Vader in his [[TIE Advanced x1/Legends|TIE Advanced x1]]. The squadron damaged his ship, putting it out of control. They were then able to leave safely.

===Battle of Endor===
Renegade Squadron's next mission was to [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. Preparations for the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] were underway, but the Rebellion needed more information on the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]]. The squadron was tasked to [[Battle of Korriban (Galactic Civil War)|intercept]] [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], who was making a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] pilgrimage to the world. A trap was laid in a Sith tomb for the Emperor. Renegade Squadron set charges by all the entrances, lured Palpatine in by destroying valuable Sith artifacts and a statue, and then detonated the explosives, trapping the Emperor inside the tomb. The squadron then stole a datapad from his shuttle, discovering that the Emperor would visit the Death Star II.

[[File:Renegade_squad_soldier.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A Renegade Squadron soldier during the Battle of Endor]]
To take the Emperor's gaze off of Endor, the squadron [[Battle of Sullust (4 ABY)|attacked]] [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]]. Renegade Squadron took the Imperial [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] on the planet. However, they met IG-88 again, this time shielded and almost invincible. Renegade Squadron destroyed the lightning conductor that was powering IG-88's shield and drove him off. However, their mission had failed, for the Emperor saw through their plan and kept his focus on Endor.

When Renegade Squadron landed on Endor, they found the situation was dire. Han Solo's team was trapped and unable to destroy the shield generator. Further, Admiral Ackbar's fleet was also trapped, forced to fight the entire Imperial fleet. The squadron liberated an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] village, destroyed several AT-STs, and sabotaged a downed AT-AT that Imperial forces were attempting to repair. With the battle beginning to go their way, Renegade Squadron rescued Han Solo and defended him while he set charges in the bunker. Renegade Squadron went on to conquer the Imperial forces on Endor.

===Dissolution===
{{Quote|And Renegade Squadron was disbanded after that?''"<br />"''We disbanded ourselves, faded back into the shadows again.|Tionne Solusar, interviewing Col Serra|<ref name="Star Wars Battlefront: Renegade Squadron" />}}
After the destruction of the second Death Star and the death of Palpatine, Renegade Squadron disbanded, with many going back to criminal lives, including Col Serra. Many years after, archivist [[Tionne Solusar]] of the Jedi Temple contacted Serra and recorded Renegade Squadron's struggles.

==Personnel and equipment==
[[File:Renegade_Squadron_X-Wing_TCG_AoEB.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A Renegade Squadron X-wing]]
Renegade Squadron was a diverse group of soldiers, most of whom had been [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and/or criminals, like [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], and gunfighters, at some point. The unit was frequently commanded by [[Col Serra]]; however, on occasion, Serra shared command with [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. Solo's co-pilot, [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], fought with Renegade Squadron in several battles, and Admiral Ackbar and the former [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[X2]] also battled alongside Renegade Squadron. Apart from these more well-known people, the squadron consisted of various [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]], [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]], [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]], and [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]]. In their battles, Renegade Squadron utilized weapons as various as its members, including [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]], [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]], [[Incinerator (weapon)|incinerators]], [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcasters]], [[Missile launcher/Legends|rocket launchers]], [[Shotgun/Legends|shotguns]], [[ARC caster]]s, [[Carbonite gun|carbonite freeze guns]], [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifles]], [[Chaingun/Legends|chainguns]], [[TriShot]]s, [[Electromagnetic pulse launcher|EMP launchers]], [[explosive blaster pistol]]s, and [[Grenade launcher/Legends|grenade launchers]]. During their frequent space battles, the squadron flew [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]], [[A-wing]]s, [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]], and [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wings]], and in one battle, they flew a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|LAAT]].

==Behind the scenes==
In the original script for ''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Renegade Squadron]]'', the squadron's name was Phantom Squadron, but it was later changed.<ref name="Blog: Storyboarding the Cutscenes">{{WebCite|url=http://www.ign.com/blogs/renegadesquadron/2007/09/19/storyboarding-the-cutscenes|text=Storyboarding the Cutscenes|date=2007-09-19|author=[[Jaime Valls Enriquez]]|work=[[Wikipedia:IGN|''IGN'']]|archivefile=File:RenegadeSquadronBlog-StoryboardingtheCutscenes-IGN.png|nolive=1}}</ref>

Renegade Squadron is not to be confused with [[Renegade Flight]], the group of starfighter pilots that first appeared in [[The Empire Strikes Back (radio)|''The Empire Strikes Back'' radio drama]].
